paragraphs.text: Laconia was Caliphear the Nightmare 's caretaker on Dominaria .

Laconia told his mistress Caliphear that her lands had fallen under attack by goblins and Shanodin Dryads . The invading creatures could not be held back by the frozen shades because the swamps had become barren due to a powerful, unknown wizard. This was later revealed to be Coldraith .
